title: Salesforce Flow Interview
description: Schema for a Salesforce Flow Interview, representing a running instance of a Flow.

Id.description: Salesforce record ID for the FlowInterview

CurrentElement.description: API name of the current flow element being executed

GuidedFlowName.description: API name of the Flow being interviewed

HasFinished.description: Whether the flow interview has completed

OwnerId.description: Salesforce ID of the interview owner

PauseLabel.description: Label for the pause element if flow is paused

CreatedDate.description: Timestamp when the interview was created

LastModifiedDate.description: Timestamp when the interview was last modified

inputs.description: Input variables passed to the flow interview

outputs.description: Output variables returned by the flow interview
